Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: This step is the primary source of the error because it fabricates an incomplete list of Daniel Craig movies under 150 minutes, omitting "Knives Out" which has a higher IMDb rating. According to Rule 2, the agent is blamed for fabricating key data that excludes the correct candidate. According to Rule 3, this omission makes the error irrecoverable in subsequent steps, as the agent cannot identify the highest-rated movie without "Knives Out" in its consideration set.
